genes.lens:
def lens(ctx, target=".", args=None):
    trace_res = ctx.call_lens("trace_locator", target=target, args=args)
    hotspot_res = ctx.call_lens("ast_hotspot", target=target, args=args)
    impact_res = ctx.call_lens("import_impact", target=target, args=args)
    frames = trace_res.get("items") or []
    spots = (hotspot_res.get("items") or [])[:5]
    tests = impact_res.get("impacted_tests") or []
    summary = f"Triage DAG: {len(frames)} frame(s), {len(spots)} top hotspot(s), {len(tests)} impacted test(s)."
    return {
        "summary": summary,
        "frames": frames,
        "hotspots": spots,
        "impacted_tests": tests,
        "tier": impact_res.get("tier", "L0"),
        "items": frames or spots,
    }

slot_specs.default: Triage DAG: {len(frames)} frame(s), {len(spots)} top hotspot(s), {len(tests)} impacted test(s).
